{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] cracked black [[Cookbook:Pepper|peppercorns]]
* ¼ cup freshly squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] juice 

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle both sides liberally with salt.
#Place pepper in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]]. Dredge chicken in black pepper. Let rest for 2–3 minutes.
#Heat a large [[Cookbook:Cast Iron|cast iron]] [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over high heat. Pour in about 2 tbsp olive oil.
#Add chicken and cook 2 minutes per side, or until browned on both sides.
#Insert an oven-safe probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into one of the chicken breasts. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]], pan and all, at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
#Remove chicken from pan and keep warm. [[Cookbook:Deglazing|Deglaze]] pan with lemon juice and drizzle over chicken. Serve warm.
